Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm Eric, one of the makers of Enter Pro.

Today, we're bringing Enter Pro to Product Hunt for the first time.

As AI models grow more capable, the barrier to coding keeps falling. But building what runs a business takes more than code.

Enter Pro is an AI-native platform that turns idea into working apps. Teams can plan, build, preview, launch, and scale apps, websites, portals, internal tools, workflows, and AI agents in one continuous workspace—with databases, authentication, storage, hosting, payments, analytics, and localization built in.

Enter started at the beginning of the year as a small experiment built around one question:

Review Z.ai?

Z.ai has received overwhelmingly positive feedback from users, who praise its impressive performance and strong capabilities in tasks like coding and creating presentations. Users highlight its potential as a leading open-source model, with some comparing it to OpenAI's offerings. The platform's ability to produce high-quality PowerPoint presentations with minimal input is particularly noted, with users appreciating the improved layout over manual efforts. Despite minor errors, the overall sentiment is that Z.ai is a powerful and recommendable tool.

#### What's great [...] What I appreciate most is that the team decided to open-source such a capable model. The AI community benefits enormously when high-quality foundation models are openly available, and I wanted to leave a review simply to thank and recognize the work that went into this release.

Looking forward to seeing how the project evolves.

#### What needs improvement

The model is already very capable. My main suggestion would be to continue improving stability and reducing occasional errors during long-running agentic workflows. As the ecosystem matures, even more consistency across extended coding sessions would make it an exceptional developer model.
